==1st Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
! width="4%" | 1
!width="24%"|''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|Section 3]]''
|width="24%"|This is one of the magical lakes where a life refilling fairy lives.  Visit here to restore your health.
!width="48%" colspan="2" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|Section 3]]''
|-
! 2
|Burn the topmost tree along the right border to reveal a cave where you can receive 30 rupees.
|This is one of the secret passage exits.  You must have the {{im/loz|Item|Power Bracelet}} in order to move the rock which opens the entrance to the passage.  The passage links to the other exits in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|Section 1]], [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|Section 7]], and directly to the south.
|width="24%"|The store inside of the cave sells (the ability to use) {{im/loz|Item|Arrows}} for 80 rupees, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 130 rupees, and a set of 4 {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} for 20 rupees.
|width="24%"|Burn one of the trees closest to the entrance to the desert to find a stairwell that leads to a medicine woman.  If you've shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, you can buy {{im/loz|Item|Red Potions}} for 68 rupees, and {{im/loz|Item|Water of Lifes}} for 40 rupees.
|-
! 3
|
|
|
|If you burn down the lower solitary tree on the left, you will reveal a stairwell that leads to 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 4
|By burning the bottom leftmost tree, you will discover a stairwell, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|
|Burn the bottom solitary tree, and you will reveal another stairwell, but the man who lives there will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|Burn down the bottom center tree among the group of trees on the right to find a stairwell.  Venture down the stairs to find a {{im/loz|Item|Red Moblin}} that is willing to part with 100 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 5
|Burn down the bottom center tree among the group of trees on the left to reveal a stairwell that leads to a medicine woman.  If you've shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, you can buy {{im/loz|Item|Red Potions}} for 68 rupees, and {{im/loz|Item|Water of Lifes}} for 40 rupees.
|This is one of the secret passage exits.  You must have the {{im/loz|Item|Power Bracelet}} in order to move the rock which opens the entrance to the passage.  The passage links to the other exits in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|Section 1]], [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|Section 7]], and directly to the north.
|
|If you bomb the wall to the left of the north path, you will reveal a cave where you can obtain a {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}.
|}
